classification._src: QD 968/QD-BSR 28/3/2024 (src_rev3/bsr_2024_03_29_board_decision.docx; md5 ghi SRC_rev3_md5.txt): muc tieu (1) 148->171 nghin thung/ngay (+15,5%), (2) san pham EURO V, (3) dat chuan moi truong theo LO TRINH BAT BUOC cua CP, (4) linh hoat dau tho; 5 phan xuong ban quyen moi GHDT, DHDT, ALK, HGU, SRU3/4 + 2 khong ban quyen SWS2, ARU2; co cau SP: FO 7->0 nghin thung, Jet 5,3->13,1, xang 65,9->79,7, DO 53,2->59,2, Propylene 462->685 t/ngay, luu huynh 13->56,7 t/ngay. Tong muc dau tu 3/2024 36.397,3 ty; NQ 5795 06/11/2026 PL2: 39.004,5 ty (vay 23.402,7 / VCSH 15.601,8), KH chi 2026 7.787,3.
classification.growth_part: tang cong suat + nang cap co cau san pham (FO->Jet/xang/PP) + linh hoat dau tho => TAO DOANH THU => NPV0 gia so (V4a)
classification.compliance_part: cum moi truong SRU3/4 + SWS2 + ARU2 (muc tieu 3 "lo trinh bat buoc") => KHONG tao doanh thu => DONG TIEN RA (V4b/D3). Euro V nhien lieu: QCVN 01:2022/BKHCN (TT 16/2022) van cho luu thong nhieu muc chat luong, CHUA thay van ban bat buoc muc 5 cho NSX => KHONG xep tuan thu o base, la kich ban.
classification.share_axis_basis: 0,10 = chi cum moi truong (ty trong chi phi [UL]: phu luc tong muc dau tu QD 968 khong cong bo); 0,40 = neu Euro V nhien lieu tro thanh bat buoc => GHDT/DHDT/HGU tinh tuan thu [UL]; 0,75 = skeptic r1 "phan lon la tuan thu" [UL]. Xac suat 0,50/0,35/0,15 [UL]. Ky vong ty trong 30,25%.
classification.tax_shield_basis: khau hao phan tuan thu duoc tru thue 10% (den 2039) ~ 10% x PV khau hao ~0,55 => -5,5% [UL]
classification.funding: 40/60 VCSH/vay (ECA + NH thuong mai); VCSH tu khau hao, loi nhuan, phat hanh CP chi khi khong du (QD 968 muc 13). Tien rong 30/09/2026 45.126 ty > 15.601,8 => base KHONG pha loang; phat hanh = kich ban thap xac suat, khong vao base.
classification.hydrotreating_rationale: GHDT/DHDT/HGU: khong bat buoc (chua thay van ban muc 5 cho NSX) => chi tieu TU NGUYEN do HDQT/DHDCD quyet => theo luat user 03/11 (khong ai bo von de mat gia tri) ghi NPV0. Bang chung tao gia tri doc lap: luu huynh thu hoi 13->56,7 t/ngay (x4,4) [QD968] = kha nang chay dau chua luu huynh cao hon (muc tieu 4 linh hoat dau tho, cau hinh Azeri 53% + ESPO 47%) => dau tho re hon; FO 7->0. Khong luong hoa duoc premium => giu NPV0 (khong NPV duong).
